library_preparation_preflight.summary: azure-data-appconfiguration is a standard azure-core-based client SDK (like the already-supported azure-identity). There is no official Docker emulator for Azure App Configuration, and none is needed: ConfigurationClientBuilder accepts a fake connectionString plus a pluggable httpClient(...), so tests can mock the HTTP transport in-process exactly like azure-identity's ManagedIdentityHttpClient pattern already in this repo. Runtime deps (azure-core, azure-json, azure-core-http-netty) are pulled in automatically as non-test-scope deps of the artifact; no extra Maven dependency, Docker image, or environment/system property is required beyond the generated scaffold.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Use a fake/dummy connection string (e.g. "Endpoint=https://example.appconfig.io;Id=fake-id;Secret=ZmFrZS1zZWNyZXQ=") with ConfigurationClientBuilder, and inject a custom HttpClient implementation (mirroring com_azure/azure_identity/ManagedIdentityResourceIdTest.java's ManagedIdentityHttpClient) that returns canned JSON responses for setConfigurationSetting/getConfigurationSetting/listConfigurationSettings/deleteConfigurationSetting and feature-flag/secret-reference settings, rather than contacting a real Azure App Configuration store.
